reports.title: Jacobs Reports Strong Fiscal Fourth Quarter and Fiscal Year 2026 Results

lines: The Company’s outlook for fiscal 2027 is for adjusted net revenue to range from $10.0B to $10.35B, adjusted EBITDA margin to range from 15.4% to 15.7%, adjusted EPS to range from $8.05 to $8.45 and for free cash flow margin to range from 8.5% to 9.5%.

desk.period: Q4 fiscal 2026 (quarter to 2 Oct 2026); also full fiscal year 2026
desk.headline: Q4 revenue up 49% to $4.7bn and adjusted EPS of $2.20 beat estimates; FY27 outlook of $8.05–8.45 adjusted EPS initiated
results: Gross revenue jumped 49% to $4.7bn, helped by more pass-through costs; adjusted net revenue, which strips those out, rose 16% to $2.59bn.
Adjusted EPS of $2.20 rose 26% and beat the $2.12 estimate; GAAP EPS from continuing operations was $1.40, up from $1.05, despite a 42.7% tax rate.
Infrastructure & Advanced Facilities net revenue grew 16% and its operating profit 23%; PA Consulting revenue grew 15% after a weaker UK patch.
Backlog reached a record $28.7bn, up 24%; the adjusted EBITDA margin widened to 16.2% from 14.4%.
For the full year, adjusted EPS rose 20% to $7.32 and adjusted free cash flow was $871m; Q4 operating cash flow fell to $270m from $383m.

guidance.summary: First outlook for fiscal 2027: adjusted net revenue of $10.0–10.35bn and adjusted EPS of $8.05–8.45, about 10–15% above FY26's $7.32. Management said FY26 had an extra week, which trims reported FY27 growth by about 2 points.

points: CEO Bob Pragada said AI-driven client spending is lifting demand in life sciences, semiconductors, energy and water.
Life sciences and advanced manufacturing grew 54% in Q4, and its pipeline is growing over 50% a year.
Data centres are about 5% of the business; Jacobs says it is being selective on speculative projects.
Management guided to about 8% organic net revenue growth in FY27 and about 75 basis points of yearly margin gains.
The CFO said at least 60% of free cash flow will go back to shareholders; net leverage was 1.6x against a 1.5x target.
call.source: Results release (Exhibit 99.1) and call coverage: Investing.com transcript, 23 Nov 2026
